a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. The storm risk is high, so if you want to change the plan, please say so openly in your message and I'll do the same. No surprise takes from me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
